display_information.name: Upwork Pipeline
display_information.description: Posts qualified Upwork jobs for approval and returns Claude-drafted proposals.
display_information.long_description: Part of the upwork-job-pipeline project. Vollna job alerts are scored by Claude, posted here as a card with Draft proposal / Skip buttons, and the resulting draft is returned in a thread. Nothing is ever submitted to Upwork automatically - every submission is a manual human action.
